method: Exact thresholded pixel boundaries; no generative redraw or curve smoothing.
author_decision: Use the supplied bold hamburger drawing as the hidden-menu entrance and the crown in Menu/About; reverse the active canvas/text colors on their compact backings.
processing_notes: EXIF orientation applied before selecting regions.
Only the supplied dark ink was traced; notebook paper, grid, purple under-marks and neighboring lettering were excluded.
Menu rotated -78 degrees and crown -29 degrees for upright UI placement; no perspective warp or generative reconstruction.
Components smaller than eight source pixels were discarded; exact retained pixel boundaries were converted to SVG with holes preserved.
The original photograph is not included in site or public builds.
